entities.summary: Félicien Menu de Ménil was a French composer and Esperanto enthusiast best known for his musical setting of L. L. Zamenhof's poem "La Espero". He was also the editor of and a contributor to La Revuo.

entities.summary: Félicien Menu de Ménil was a French composer and Esperanto enthusiast best known for his musical setting of L. L. Zamenhof's poem "La Espero". He was also the editor of and a contributor to La Revuo.
